connector.name: Snowflake MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: A Snowflake MCP server - SQL queries, schema exploration, and data insights for AI assistants
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-snowflake-server-nsp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nsphung account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: SNOWFLAKE_AUTHENTICATOR
env.description: Authentication method. Defaults to 'snowflake' if not set. Valid values: snowflake, externalbrowser, snowflake_jwt, oauth, oauth_client_credentials

env.name: SNOWFLAKE_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE
env.description: Absolute path to .p8 private key file

env.name: SNOWFLAKE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
env.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID (required for oauth_client_credentials authenticator)

env.name: SNOWFLAKE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: OAuth 2.0 client secret (required for oauth_client_credentials authenticator)

env.name: SNOWFLAKE_OAUTH_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL
env.description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint URL (required for oauth_client_credentials authenticator)

env.name: SNOWFLAKE_TOKEN
env.description: Pre-fetched OAuth bearer token (required for oauth authenticator)
